verdict.rationale: Unity documents several ways for an agent to drive the editor. The official MCP server connects agents like Claude Code and Cursor to the Unity Editor, and the AI Assistant performs project actions. The first-party CLI's `unity <command>`/`unity eval` drive the Editor directly. Command-line arguments with batchmode/headless runs and build profiles cover automated builds, and the public scripting APIs and AssetDatabase give programmatic control. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating scenes/GameObjects and editing properties through these agent interfaces, a stable status (the CLI is experimental and the in-editor MCP server is beta/deprecated), and independent hands-on corroboration.
